summary.text: Christopher Hendricks is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 11th Bristol District since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Hendricks took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 2, 2019, succeeding Robert Koczera.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Steering, Policy and Scheduling Committee and a member of the Community Development and Small Businesses Joint, Economic Development and Emerging Technologies Joint, and Transportation Joint committees.
